description: ONE 0-100 BUY SCORE, NO SIZE NEEDED. Should you buy this Arc pool? One call returns a score and a call (ok, caution or avoid) from the pool fee, the hook's permission bits, our latest sell probe (re-run when older than 10 minutes), what the pool's first buyer did, and whether its pools are empty. "avoid" only with evidence; every input is shown. To test a sell at your own size, or to see whether the liquidity can be pulled, use arc_exit_check. $0.002 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

pool.description: Uniswap v4 pool id on Arc (pass this or token)
